titleTr: Zor bir gün: so, such, despite

grammar.topic: so / such and despite / in spite of
explainTr: 'So' sıfat ya da zarfın önüne gelir: so tired, so loud. 'Such' isim ister: such a long day, such nice kids. Çoğul veya sayılamayan isimde 'a' düşer.
İki cümleyi sonuçla bağlamak için 'so ... that' ve 'such ... that' kullanılır: The room was so noisy that I could not think.
'Despite' ve 'in spite of' 'rağmen' demektir; arkasından isim ya da -ing gelir: Despite the rain... 'Although' ise arkasından tam cümle ister.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'çok yorucu bir gün' ya da 'öyle yorgundum ki' diyebiliyoruz. İngilizcede 'çok' sıfata gelirse so, isme gelirse such kullanılır. 'Rağmen' için Türkçe tek kelime yeter; İngilizcede despite + isim, although + cümle ayrımı var.

examples.en: I was so tired that I fell asleep.
It was such a long day.
Despite the noise, she stayed calm.
In spite of being nervous, Hafsa said yes.
examples.tr: Gergin olmasına rağmen Hafsa evet dedi.

examples.en: Although it was late, we kept working.
examples.tr: Geç olmasına rağmen çalışmaya devam ettik.

exercises.q: The children were ___ noisy that I could not hear myself think.
It was ___ a long day that I fell asleep on the bus.
exercises.whyTr: 'a + isim' öncesinde 'such' gelir: such a long day.

exercises.q: Hafsa has ___ many forms to fill out this week.
They are ___ nice students that I want to stay in this class.
exercises.whyTr: Çoğul isimle 'such' gelir, 'a' konmaz: such nice students.

exercises.q: ___ the rain, the class had recess outside.
___ she was tired, Hafsa finished the sub plan.
exercises.whyTr: Arkasında özne + fiil var, o yüzden 'Although'.

exercises.answer: Despite being tired, Hafsa stayed late
It was such a hard day
exercises.whyTr: Kalıp: such + a + sıfat + tekil isim.

exercises.q: In spite of ___ sick, he came to school.
exercises.whyTr: 'In spite of' den sonra isim ya da -ing gelir.

exercises.q: Mr. Brown said, "I am busy." → Mr. Brown said that he ___ busy.
exercises.whyTr: Dolaylı anlatımda zaman bir adım geriye gider: am → was.

exercises.q: Yesterday Linda ___ me about her class.
The movie was ___ boring that we left early.

reading.title: Hafsa's first day as a sub
reading.text:
On Tuesday morning, Mr. Brown called Hafsa. "Ms. Carter is sick, and we need a substitute for her fourth-grade class. Can you come today?" Hafsa was nervous, but she said yes. In spite of her fear, she took a deep breath and drove to Lincoln Elementary.

It was such a difficult day. The students were so excited about a new teacher that they would not sit down. Two boys argued about a pencil, and a girl cried because she lost her notebook. The noise was so loud that the teacher next door knocked on the door. Hafsa felt frustrated and exhausted. She had almost no time to think, and the sub plan was longer than she expected.

Then she tried something simple. She stood at the front of the room, stayed calm, and whispered, "Whoever is quiet gets a sticker." Slowly, the room became quiet. Despite the chaos in the morning, the afternoon went much better. The class read a story together, and the children were so proud of their drawings that they showed them to everyone.

At 3:30, Mr. Brown asked, "How was your day?" Hafsa laughed. "It was exhausting, but I learned a lot." That evening she told Emre about it. "It was such a hard day, Mom," he said, "but you did it!" She smiled. She was tired, yet she felt happy.

questions.q: Why did Mr. Brown call Hafsa?
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'Ms. Carter is sick, and we need a substitute.'

questions.q: Why did the teacher next door knock?
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'The noise was so loud that the teacher next door knocked.'

questions.q: How did Hafsa get the class quiet?
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'She ... whispered, Whoever is quiet gets a sticker.'

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: Hafsa, you look exhausted. How was your first day?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: It was such a hard day, Linda! The children were so noisy that I could not hear myself.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: Oh no. What did you do?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Despite my fear, I stayed calm. I whispered, and slowly they became quiet.

script.speaker: Linda

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: A little frustrated, but not angry. Two boys argued about a pencil.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: Kids do that. Will you go back?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Yes. In spite of everything, I enjoyed the afternoon. The children drew such beautiful pictures!

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: I am so proud of you. Come for tea tomorrow and tell me more.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Thank you, I would love to. I am so tired now, but I am happy.

writing.promptTr: Zor geçen bir gününü anlat. so / such ve despite / in spite of kullan (80-100 kelime).
writing.promptEn: Write about a hard day. Use so / such and despite / in spite of (80-100 words).
writing.model: Last Friday was such a difficult day. I had so many things to do that I did not have time for lunch. My son Emre was sick, and the bus was late. In spite of everything, I finished my work. Despite feeling tired, I cooked dinner for Emre. I was so happy when he smiled and said thank you. Now I know that I can handle a hard day. Next time I will plan my morning better, and I will ask my neighbor Linda for help if I need it.
checklistTr: En az bir 'so + sıfat + that' cümlen var mı?
Despite / In spite of'tan sonra isim ya da -ing geldi mi (cümle değil)?
Cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor ve noktayla bitiyor mu?
